briefdescription.para: Zero Width Joiner (U+200D), used in emoji sequences.
Internal state: inside a Regional Indicator pair.
Unicode Grapheme Cluster Break property values (UAX #29).

detaileddescription.para: Used to determine grapheme cluster boundaries for correct cursor movement and character deletion in the terminal. Each codepoint is assigned one of these properties to drive the break algorithm.
Used to handle conjunct cluster boundaries in Indic scripts (e.g. Devanagari, Bengali). Required for correct grapheme segmentation of Indic text.

Standard Unicode general categories as defined in the Unicode Character Database. Used by CharProps to classify codepoints for rendering decisions (e.g. whether a character is a letter, number, punctuation, or control).

briefdescription.para: Bits to shift codepoint for T1 index (divides into 256-entry blocks).
Mask for low byte of codepoint (selects within a 256-entry block).
Bit shift for extracting display width from packed property value.
Level-1 multistage table for character properties.

detaileddescription.para: Maps the high byte of a codepoint (cp >> 8) to a block index into charPropsT2. Identical 256-codepoint blocks share the same T1 entry, providing compression.
Size: 4352 entries (covers U+0000 to U+10FFFF in 256-codepoint blocks)

briefdescription.para: Level-2 multistage table for character properties.

detaileddescription.para: Maps a (T1 block index, low byte) pair to an index into graphemeSegT3. Multiple codepoints with identical properties share the same T3 index, providing the second level of compression.
Size: 46592 entries (uint16_t), covering all unique 256-codepoint blocks referenced by charPropsT1.

briefdescription.para: Level-3 (leaf) table containing packed character property values.

detaileddescription.para:
Each entry encodes multiple properties for a codepoint in a packed uint16_t:
Grapheme break property (GraphemeBreakProperty)
Indic Conjunct Break property (IndicConjunctBreak)
Unicode general category (UnicodeCategory)
Display width (extracted via WIDTH_SHIFT)
Size: 550 entries — the set of all unique property combinations present in Unicode 17.0.0.

briefdescription.para: Generated Unicode character property lookup tables.

detaileddescription.para:
DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE MANUALLY. This file is generated by gen_char_props.py from the Unicode Character Database (UCD). Any manual edits will be overwritten on the next regeneration.
This file contains three-level multistage lookup tables for Unicode character properties used by the terminal renderer. The tables encode:
Grapheme break properties (UAX #29 Unicode Text Segmentation)
Indic Conjunct Break properties
Unicode general categories
Display width (narrow/wide/ambiguous)

simplesect.para: Built from Unicode Standard 17.0.0. Regenerate by running: gen_char_props.py
